_about: Hans Christian Andersen (1805-1875) in public-domain English translations, each title carrying its translator. Andersen has no single canonical English edition, so several Victorian translators are held side by side as separate works: H. W. Dulcken (Stories for the Household, What the Moon Saw), Mary Howitt (the first English Andersen, 1846, and his autobiography and novels), Caroline Peachey, Anna Bushby, Fanny Fuller, H. L. Brækstad, Mrs. Edgar Lucas, and W. A. Craigie's 1914 revision. Where a Gutenberg file names no translator, the title says so. Gutenberg is clean text; Internet Archive is raw OCR. All published before 1930: US public domain.

andersen-fairy-tales-paull: Fairy Tales of Hans Christian Andersen (translator not named in the Gutenberg file; its wording matches the text usually credited to Mrs. H. B. Paull, 1872 — unverified)
